name: code-snippets
notes: Adapter-authoring probe 2026-08-22: inspected the official WordPress.org Code Snippets 3.9.6 artifact (SHA-256 ab5822db426858b43d7c010481a87d0eaffb056cc483e93e057d96f6e6fdd4f4). php/class-db.php supplies the complete 12-column single-site snippets schema used below; the multisite-only ms_snippets table is outside Duo's single-site contract.

Snippet rows use mapped identity because the plugin has no stable unique natural key: names are editable and not uniqueness-constrained. name/description/code/tags/scope/priority/active are the portable snippet definition. modified and revision are write-history state, cloud_id binds optional cloud provenance, and condition_id belongs to the plugin's condition subsystem rather than a declared single-site snippet entity graph.

The code_snippet and code_snippet_source shortcodes each accept both id and snippet_id aliases; both point at snippets.id and therefore require the code_snippet token kind. The packaged free 3.9.6 source contains a string check for a code-snippets/source block but no block registration or exact attribute schema, so no block_attrs rule is guessed.

code_snippets_settings mixes portable editor preferences with version-switch controls and enable_flat_files. The current option grammar cannot carry selected nested keys while also proving the plugin's generated flat-file execution tree was rebuilt, so the whole settings row stays environment-owned. Apply is promotion-blocked until a bounded provider invokes clean_snippets_cache() and, when Snippet_Files::is_active(), the plugin's code_snippets/settings_updated rebuild path with an independently verified receipt.
